units.source_text: 我家小姐竟像是不知情趣的人。

en.t: Our young lady seems almost like someone with no sense of romantic feeling.

units.source_text: 此事昨夜老太太向你不问自告，想你已闻悉了吧。”

en.t: The old lady told you about this last night of her own accord, so I imagine you have already heard it.”

units.source_text: 中将觉得此信平凡，毫不足观，看罢就丢在一旁了。

en.t: The Captain found the letter ordinary and not worth looking at, and after reading it he tossed it aside.
